name: Ayanokoji Megumi
source:
The protagonist's female friend.
A second-year student in the English and American Literature Department at Komainu University.
Kind and easygoing, she is the mediator between Kobayan and Zaki.
She works hard, but her test scores are always poor because of her nervousness.
